title: 美巴谈判：仍存分歧，今日启动25%关税
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: You were just on a panel and you said you have an aversion to making news. I'm going to try nonetheless.
segments.zh: 你刚在小组讨论中说你不喜欢制造新闻，但我还是想试试。

segments.en: I think there are a lot of folks wondering about Brazil in particular, as soon as this test case for the Section 301 tariffs.
segments.zh: 很多人特别关注巴西，作为301关税的测试案例。

segments.en: Statutory deadline is today. Anything you can say about the process and where it stands and what we can expect.
segments.zh: 法定截止日期是今天。你能谈谈流程进展和预期吗？

segments.en: It's today. So our Section 301 investigations, they are legal investigations.
segments.zh: 就是今天。我们的301调查是法律调查。

segments.en: We have two sets of hearings. We do two sets of public comments.
segments.zh: 我们有两轮听证会和两轮公众意见征集。

segments.en: And we're focused on unfair trading practices by Brazil.
segments.zh: 我们关注的是巴西的不公平贸易行为。

segments.en: So we have to have a legal basis to do this. And there are all kinds of things that Brazil has been doing.
segments.zh: 所以必须有法律依据。巴西做了很多事。

segments.en: They've been censoring our digital tech companies.
segments.zh: 他们审查我们的数字科技公司。

segments.en: They've been restricting our access for ethanol to their market.
segments.zh: 他们限制我们的乙醇进入其市场。

segments.en: They've been actually engaging in illegal deforestation in the Amazon, which gives them a leg up on all the ag where they displace our ag exports to third countries.
segments.zh: 他们还在亚马逊非法砍伐，这让他们在农业上获得优势，挤占我们对第三国的农产品出口。

segments.en: So there are a lot of things like this that have been problem for a long time with Brazil.
segments.zh: 类似问题与巴西已存在很久。

segments.en: So we've been investigating this. Today we'll announce our final action.
segments.zh: 我们一直在调查，今天将宣布最终措施。

segments.en: I had a conversation, a video conversation with my counterpart, Brazil last night.
segments.zh: 昨晚我与巴西同行进行了视频通话。

segments.en: Very cordial. We've had intensive negotiations with them.
segments.zh: 非常友好，我们进行了密集谈判。

segments.en: I think there's still a lot of gaps between us. So we probably have to have some kind of action, but then continue discussions I think.
segments.zh: 双方仍有不少分歧，可能需采取行动，但会继续对话。

segments.en: Expectation 25% in line with what you're thinking in terms of the range.
segments.zh: 预期25%，与您考虑的区间一致？

segments.en: Well, this is what was proposed by my office at the President's direction.
segments.zh: 这是根据总统指示由我方办公室提出的。

segments.en: So this is probably what we're looking at.
segments.zh: 所以这大概就是我们的考虑。

segments.en: Again, I don't want to get ahead of the President. He's signing something today. I just got off the phone with him.
segments.zh: 我不想抢先，总统今天会签署文件，我刚与他通话。

segments.en: And so we'll have more details to come. But again, I just want to emphasize.
segments.zh: 更多细节稍后公布，但我想强调一点。
